name: hidx_sel_g4p-g4p-COMMIT
purpose: HBM-IDXPIPE 10-18: FALLBACK of hidx_sel_g4 (55 logic levels) = the pipelined selector core 98f4b19a7 (SRAM read registered; compare+tie prefix, tie-budget mask, one-hot prefix pack, barrel merge, registered write; histogram H1/H2/H3; reset via ot_rst_relay, datapath unreset) on the g4 one-root shell (clk_ctl clocks every flop and all 12 SRAMs). Same d4g slot 600x450, macro placement, faces and pins as hidx_sel_g4. Calendar (tools/hbm_idx_static_calendar.py): sel_core_out +2 (link fields +2), sel_scan_drain +2 per scan pass; with the pipelined link (--link-pipe 5) the IDX frame is 1397 -> 1408 edges. Benches run_selector.sh SHELL=1 on the die master: MUT0 pass / MUT1 (ties) / MUT2 (emitted ID) fail.
